head: b602404
summary: Implemented the executable with actual Agent Framework tools, official Responses hosting, a service-authenticated REST gateway, shared settling, guarded composition and checkpointed confirmation. Fixed conductor CA2026 by disposing the workflow test JsonDocument after cloning its reply element. Whole-solution warning-as-error build, format and all 1,509 fast tests pass under both SDK 10.0.404 from dotnet and root SDK 11.0.100; the target remains net10.0. All 39 deterministic records and 431 orchestrator cases pass. All 313 named guarantees are indexed (156 E, 103 P, 15 U, 39 X), not claimed as 313 equivalent passing tests. Cross-surface figure parity remains dependent on gateway/integration work; deployment is unverified. The head names the repair commit; this status/log commit is its descendant. Nothing was pushed.

deviations.what: An uncertain mutation retains a recovery-only framework checkpoint and its original idempotency identity. Unrelated reads continue, but another prepare and confirmation stay blocked.
deviations.why: The source clears pending confirmation after uncertainty. Retaining non-confirmable recovery state prevents accidental repetition; IMP-orchestrator-1 records the deliberate safety difference.

deviations.what: Startup refuses disabled injection/output controls and disabled gateway TLS verification.
deviations.why: These optional source diagnostic overrides are not silently ignored. The stricter hosted posture and the need for an owner decision are explicit in IMP-orchestrator-2.

deviations.what: Malformed boolean settings fail startup instead of silently becoming false.
deviations.why: A configuration typo must not quietly disable an intended control. Supported values and every deterministic record retain their behavior; see IMP-orchestrator-3.

deviations.what: O5 is partial only for complete golden/cross-surface parity evidence; its local guard, lane, placeholder, reference and composition implementation is exercised.
deviations.why: The complete source model-scripted golden corpora and real portal/API/gateway/MCP figure matrix are not certified by these local fake-gateway proofs. The named index identifies narrower or absent assertions rather than manufacturing equivalence.

findings: The conductor's root SDK 11.0.100 detects CA2026 in an inline JsonDocument.Parse(body).RootElement.Clone() expression that the prescribed SDK 10.0.404 build accepted. Explicit using disposal fixes the leak without requiring newer target APIs or suppressing analysis.
The captured Resolve/yes/yes conversation performs eligibility reads, not a prepare/commit flow. Actual checkpointed writes are proved separately.
keyword.10 is a clarification, not a successful simulation; keyword.19 uses injection-screened keyword planning rather than an invented refusal.
Global data_catalog runs before client resolution; a bare year can invoke ordinary eligibility fallback and must not be assumed to mean help or review-pack resumption.
Actual .NET SDK explicit conversation/response-chain context outranks the client header fallback.
The framework requires DependencyInjection and Abstractions >=10.0.13; central 10.0.0 pins were insufficient. The approved owned section updates existing declarations.
The resolved Azure graph exports overlapping DefaultAzureCredential type names; an assembly alias resolves the ambiguity without changing shared projects.
A package-link cancellation test needed an explicit read-start signal. The executor now preserves known successful mutation evidence even when SDK cancellation wins during its subsequent read.
The complete source test index has explicit partial/unverified/outside-scope rows. Neither passing theory counts nor W2 publications are full source-guarantee or .NET deployment certification.
No engine figure, pinned constant, recording, Python implementation, remote or infrastructure file was changed.

needs_human.item: W4 trusted hosting ingress and employer binding
needs_human.why: The .NET SDK does not expose Python's original-subject object. The seam maps platform-injected headers and SDK context; real ingress must authenticate callers and strip or replace spoofable assertions before private data is used. No .NET deployment or live identity proof was performed.

needs_human.item: Gateway capability integration and complete figure-parity matrix
needs_human.why: The orchestrator uses the existing /channel/v1 REST contract. Parallel gateway bindings and real API/portal/MCP integration must supply the complete cross-surface proof. Local scripted envelopes are not certification of every real capability producer.

WriteWorkflow.RecoverAsync supports a read-only lookup with the original idempotency identity, but the existing gateway contract has no agreed result-recovery endpoint. No endpoint was invented. Decide operational reconciliation, slot capacity/retirement and process/replica durability before relying on fleet-wide exactly-once behavior.
Decide whether the source's diagnostic off switches should be supported later. This runtime explicitly refuses them and preserves the default-on behavior; it never silently weakens a control.

Captured ingestion can override year-resolved wage_basis, measuring_date and pay codes. The ported calculation behavior is unchanged because correcting it can change figures; owner reconciliation is required.
credit_math prices the first program for a state with several programs. The orchestrator does not reinterpret or refuse that inherited figure; the owner must decide any calculation change.

needs_human.item: Snapshot, live retrieval and remaining coverage limits
needs_human.why: Count/max source fingerprints are not snapshots. Live Foundry, Fabric, Entra, network diagnostics and knowledge retrieval were not exercised. The source golden matrices and 15 unverified named control/documentation assertions remain visible in the traceability index.
